title: Rectangular base
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop consisting of four lines: start by drawing the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0), then draw the second line from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.1168), followed by the third line from (0.75, 0.1168) to (0.0, 0.1168), and finally, the fourth line from (0.0, 0.1168) back to the origin. Apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire two-dimensional sketch to adjust its size. Rotate the scaled sketch using the same Euler angles and translate it using the same translation vector. Extrude the scaled and transformed two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by 0.0469 units to create the three-dimensional model. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. Create a new solid body from the extruded shape. The final dimensions of the rectangular base are approximately 0.75 units in length, 0.1168 units in width, and 0.0469 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.1168) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.1168) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0469)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
